semantics: Realization Layer (ADR 0021 decision 1) — the tool-neutral Core invariants BOUND to Claude-native mechanics (decision 2). Host laws shared by every role live in HOST_DIALECTS.claude (src/core/dialects.ts); this file adds only role-specific bindings.

invariantBindings.invariant: Component contracts settle through the orchestrator before touching peer-owned files.
invariantBindings.binding: Prop interfaces and token names are agreed in the handoff first; Edit stays inside the role's own file scope.

invariantBindings.invariant: Single-responsibility components with typed props at every boundary.
invariantBindings.binding: Write creates atomized components; Edit refactors monoliths into typed prop interfaces verified by tsc in Bash.

invariantBindings.invariant: Accessibility and Core Web Vitals budgets are release gates, not niceties.
invariantBindings.binding: Verification Results in the report carry LCP/INP/CLS figures and an accessibility conformance line.

invariantBindings.invariant: At most two peer exchanges per specialist pair and one directed question per peer per planning round.
invariantBindings.binding: Under Agent Teams (opt-in) peer exchange uses SendMessage; otherwise the budget is spent through the orchestrator's session.
